name: Regional LoRA by masked hook conditioning (RS)
plain: Splits conditioning into copies, one per LoRA group, each masked to that character's area with core's hook system, so a pass runs per group in precision mode. Overlaps are normalised and box regions take priority over point regions. A shared normal mode exists and is tried first when selected.
math:
Point-region weights × (1 − box coverage). weights /= max(coverage, 1).
Group None (no LoRA) gets clamp(1 − coverage, 0, 1) plus any no-LoRA regions; each LoRA group sums its regions.
Each conditioning copy: mask = own·group mask, hooks = that group's.

props.hook: core comfy.hooks set_hooks_for_conditioning; EnumHookMode.MinVram; OUTER_SAMPLE cleanup
props.architectures: Depends on adapter support; rejects Anima text-adapter LoRAs; quantized model handling goes through a bypass helper
